content.text:
I found the bug. In `UploadedFile.svelte` at line 98, the close button inside the "Pasted Content" modal has `hover:text-gray-800` — which makes the icon nearly invisible in dark mode because `gray-800` is very dark and blends into the dark modal background.

`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
- Tailwind's `hover:text-*` utility only applies in light mode unless paired with a `dark:hover:text-*` variant. When designing interactive elements, always pair light-mode hover states with their dark-mode counterparts.
- The `gray-800` color (`#1f2937`) is almost identical to a dark-theme background, causing the icon to "vanish" on hover — a common pitfall when light-mode-only hover colors are applied.
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`

- The fix adds `dark:hover:text-gray-200` — a light gray — as the hover color specifically for dark mode, making the `×` icon clearly visible against a dark background when hovered.
- `gray-200` (`#e5e7eb`) provides strong contrast on dark surfaces without being harsh white, maintaining visual consistency with the rest of the dark UI.
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`

The fix is a one-class addition to `src/lib/components/chat/UploadedFile.svelte:98`. The close button inside the Pasted Content modal now uses `dark:hover:text-gray-200` on hover in dark mode, instead of the dark `hover:text-gray-800` that was causing it to disappear against the dark background.
